title: Formal smoothness of B -> C makes C (x)_B Omega_{B/A} -> Omega_{C/A} injective
statement: Let $A\to B\to C$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings, $C$ an $A$-algebra through the composite, and assume $C$ is formally smooth over $B$, i.e. formally smooth over $B$ for the $\mathfrak n$-adic topology with $\mathfrak n=0$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic] (for every ring $D$ with a ring map $B\to D$, every ideal $J\subseteq D$ with $J^2=0$ and every $B$-algebra map $g:C\to D/J$ there is a $B$-algebra map $f:C\to D$ lifting $g$). Let $\Omega$ and $\mathrm d$ be the Kähler differentials and universal derivations of [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. Then the $C$-linear map $$u:C\otimes_B\Omega_{B/A}\longrightarrow\Omega_{C/A},\qquad c\otimes\mathrm d_{B/A}b\longmapsto c\,\mathrm d_{C/A}(\bar b)$$ ($\bar b$ the image of $b$ in $C$) is injective.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 031K (lemma-ses-formally-smooth): for A -> B -> C with B -> C formally smooth, 0 -> Omega_{B/A} (x)_B C -> Omega_{C/A} -> Omega_{C/B} -> 0 is split short exact; the injectivity of the first map is the part stated here (tag verified in stacks-project/tags/tags: 031K,algebra-lemma-ses-formally-smooth)

split_report.summary: Read Stacks Algebra 031K (lemma-ses-formally-smooth, tag verified) and its proof, which is 'follows from Proposition 031J (proposition-characterize-formally-smooth) and Lemma 00S2 (lemma-exact-sequence-NL)': formal smoothness of B -> C gives H_1(L_{C/B}) = 0, and 00S2 gives H_1(L_{C/B}) -> C ⊗_B Ω_{B/A} -> Ω_{C/A} exact. No sorry-free slopmaster2 declaration states it (grep of WeilConjectures and Comparator for the id, mapBaseChange, H1Cotangent: none; the id is not in dag/lean_names_upstream.json). Statement checked against 031K and kept; stmt_deps kept.
